name: Lille Mølle

menus.name: tasting menu
menus.note: Prestige wine menu DKK 2,295, mixed drinks DKK 1,295, NoLo drinks menu DKK 1,195 (7 glasses each). No vegetarian or vegan menu.

bookingOpens: Online through the restaurant's booking page (EasyTable). Reservations for 2026 are open; newsletter subscribers get early access to new dates. Open Wednesday to Saturday from 6pm.
cancellation: Free cancellation up to 5 days before. Later than that, the restaurant may charge the full menu price (DKK 1,795) per guest. Fewer guests on the day are not refunded.
waitlist: If no table is free on the date you want, join the waiting list on the booking page and the restaurant will contact you if a seat comes up.
groups: Groups of up to 60, and a private dining room for up to 24; ask by email.
photoAlt: The ivy-covered Lille Mølle house dated 1669 in Christianshavn, Copenhagen
